text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: GPU pool us-west-2/gpu-pool-42 queue growth >85% for 3m. Autoscaler reported failure to scale: scale_state=limiting, reason=quota_exhausted. Thread root ts 5420001234

pagerduty: PAGER: maria (on-call) — page sent (severity: high)

maria: on it. seeing big queue spikes on us-west-2. autoscaler not adding nodes like it normally does. any idea what changed?

oliver: looks correlated with model rollout v3.4 that went global ~10m ago. ctx-length distribution shifted right, kv-cache entries ballooned. top consumers: model:v3.4 — avg ctx x4.

sophie: confirmed. per-GPU throughput down ~35%. prefill volumes up. Current queued requests: model:v3.4 = 7200, others combined ~300.

maria: support is seeing customer errors/latency. @liz-support can you confirm impacted accounts?

liz-support: 3 enterprise customers have open tickets (timeouts and long tail latencies). They're seeing p95 of 8-12s. Eng tickets coming in.

deploy-bot: Deploy record: v3.4 rolled at 5420000700 by @oliver (canary -> global).

kevin: if it's the rollout, can we rollback to v3.3 quickly? need to weigh rollback time vs mitigation knobs.

oliver: rollback possible. root cause seems to be v3.4 default prefill/prompt handling increasing kvcache and prefill cost. Quick mitigations: route v3.4 traffic to dedicated burst pools (quota limited), reduce per-request prefill, or rollback.

sophie: autoscaler logs: `scale_limit_reached: true` and vendor quota exhausted in region. So scaling out is blocked until quota bump.

maria: options list: 1) rollback v3.4 (fastest reliable) 2) global rate-limit v3.4 via routing rules 3) aggressive kv-ttl trim to shrink cache (risky for correctness). I recommend rollback + customer comms.

oliver: we can also try a quick config patch to trim kvcache: `redwoodctl model set --id v3.4 --kvcache-ttl 60s` — should reduce memory footprint while we rollback.

maria: decision: roll back canary then global if green. @kevin please take post-rollback monitoring handoff.

maria: rolling back canary now.

deploy-bot: Rollback started: v3.4 -> v3.3 (canary) at 5420001330.

incident-bot: quick analysis: queue growth correlates with `prefill_token_limit=16000` set by v3.4 default. Prefill wave amplification seen in telemetry. Logs sample:```
[5420001288] model=v3.4 prefill_start id=abc123 tokens=15872 mem_kv=12.4GB
[5420001290] queue_len=3420 gpu_util=92% kvcache_entries=1.2M
[5420001305] autoscaler: attempt_scale_out -> denied (quota_exhausted)
```

sophie: running `redwoodctl autoscaler logs --region us-west-2 --last 15m` shows repeated scale attempts failing with `quota_exceeded`.

oliver: quick patch applied: `redwoodctl model set --id v3.4 --kvcache-ttl 60s` at 5420001355 to try short-term relief. Not a long-term solution.

deploy-bot: Rollback progress: canary traffic -> v3.3 at 5420001420 (approx 60% of canary shifted).

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: v3.3 at 5420001450, global traffic adjusted.

kevin: seeing immediate improvements: queued requests down 7.2k -> 900 in ~3m; p95 latency dropped from ~10s to ~1.2s. Good signal. I'll continue to monitor for 30m.

maria: customer impact summary (preliminary): 5 affected customers, transient latency spikes and elevated error rate (~0.8% additional errors) during 5420001200-5420001450 window. No data loss. SEs notified.

liz-support: I've sent interim notifications to affected accounts with explanation and ETA for postmortem.

sophie: follow-up actions: 1) Add rollout gating to check avg context length and kv growth under canary for at least 15m. 2) Add model metadata label for kvcache budget. 3) Autoscaler should surface quota_exhausted as a blocking rollout condition.

oliver: filing ticket: RD-INC-5420 "v3.4 rollout kvcache amplification" assigning @oliver and @kevin. Will include repro and perf logs.

kevin: I'll request quota bump from cloud provider (support ticket) but we shouldn't rely on quota as the main mitigation.

maria: handoff: I'm unpaging and handing monitoring to @kevin. Kevin, take lead on RCA and postmortem draft. I'll help with timeline and deploy logs.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated — status=mitigated, mitigated_ts=5420001800, duration~23m.

kevin: acknowledged. I'll publish an RCA in #postmortems by EOD and include the customer-facing summary.

liz-support: I'll follow up customers with a short summary and the timeline.

maria: thanks all — nice quick rollback. We'll add the gating and kvcache budget checks before next major model rollout.

kevin: taking over monitoring. marking handoff complete. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Note: follow-up ticket created RD-INC-5420; owners: oliver, kevin, sophie.

maria: unpaging now. closing thread for active response.

liz-support: prepping post-incident comms to affected customers (will attach monitoring graphs).

kevin: keeping watch for 60m then will move to RCA.

sophie: adding automated canary checks PR in infra repo: https://git.redwood/internal/infra/pull/5420

oliver: will add model metadata label and canary test in the model onboarding flow.

maria: thanks team, nice coordination. :raised_hands:
